info.name: Revenue per provider for all apps

params.name: from
params.description: Start date (ISO 8601 yyyy-MM-dd, UTC). Defaults to one month before `to`. The from/to window must not exceed 31 days.

params.name: to
params.description: End date (ISO 8601 yyyy-MM-dd, UTC). Defaults to the current date.

params.name: countries
params.description: Comma-separated ISO Alpha-2 country codes to filter revenue by. Omit for all countries.

items.docs: Returns total revenue per survey provider for all apps over a date range, optionally filtered by country.
